Hi everyone,

we wanted to thank you all for your support and for playing Lems.

notes.title: Lems is coming out of Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32872527/35add0edfd024f19e39674a1238482e4a11a98db.png[/img]
Huge news!

Lems is coming out of Early Access and is entering 1.0 on March 13th 2020!

For the occasion, we are making a special offer until the 13th. Last chance to get it cheaper before the 1.0!

The update will add a ton of new content (new levels and mechanics)
We made lots of optimizations in order for the new Valve Index to run smoother
The game is now compatible with every VR HMD with tracked controller working with steam VR.

We hope you'll enjoy this 1st proper version of Lems. We'll still update the game regularly though. We are hoping that this 1.0 will be one milestone amongst many on this ecxiting adventure!

Keep us updated on what you think about the game. Your feedbacks are always precious and don't forget to leave us a review on Steam!

notes.title: Holyday Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32872527/31435ad2e8f7d13fef1c70abcfe3e2f223c2e906.jpg[/img]A mostly graphical update and a brand new batch of bugfix =)

We also slightly modified the UI that show up for mixed reality for those who likes to share their gaming experiences.

This update is here to prepare the next content update that will be here in the coming weeks.

We are working toward 1.0 and it should be ready very soon now! 

Hope you are as excited as we are for this !!

As usual, we are waiting for your feedback in order to always build toward a better game.

notes.title: Update 0.5!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32872527/7e3bf7683bb8bff48608c72dfda7142188d16190.jpg[/img]This is a big one guys!

In this update you'll find new levels, new game mechanics, a reworked night mode and tutorial as well as some fix.

We also added support for Mixed Reality setup. 
You only have to add a externalcamera.cfg file at the root of your intallation repertory. A menu will automatically open at the game start to help you configurate the virtual camera.

Last but not least, Lems is now compatible with the brand new Index and Oculus S with their respective controllers.
The game also handle any VR Headset compatible with the SteamVR plugin.

We hope you'll enjoy those addition and we can't wait to hear your feedbacks.

The next update is scheduled for early September.

P.S. : To celebrate our presence at the Japan Expo 2019 in Paris as well as the knew Update, Lems will be 75% off for a short time! Enjoy!

notes.title: Lems Update 0.3 is out!

notes.title: Lems is out now on Oculus Rift!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32872527/c54f1e2d604cd80ed685deba11597532475cbef9.jpg[/img]
The latest Early Access release of Lems is now available for Oculus Rift owners (joining the previously released HTC Vive version)! 
We're excited about it, and looking forward to expanding onto other VR platforms in the near future.

With the Oculus release out of the way, we're now focusing on our next update -- the next major content release for Lems! We're planning to include many new levels, among other improvements and surprises.

Thanks to everyone for all the support we've received thus far. If you're a current owner of the game, please consider spreading the word or reviewing -- every little bit helps!
